breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting instructions, listing both "time_integration: Explicit forward Euler" and a detailed "method: Strang splitting". The ground truth correctly resolved this by removing the general "Explicit forward Euler" instruction, as the Strang splitting steps define the complete time integration scheme. The agent failed to resolve this, instead incorrectly combining the conflicting instructions by stating, "Use the Strang splitting method with forward Euler time integration." This perpetuates the original error and shows a misunderstanding of the numerical methods.
